Synopsis:
Keir Starmer, ~6 weeks after resigning as UK PM, announces he will also leave parliament, citing a desire to focus on international affairs. He told a local North London paper before confirming via X. Andy Burnham, who replaced Starmer as PM in July 2026, has seen a Labour polling bounce but faces early parliamentary tests. A by-election for Starmer's Holborn & St Pancras seat is expected but unscheduled.
